Consider oral manifestations of systemic disease

Teeth

  • GERD (Dissolves enamel)
  • Sjögren’s Syndrome (Dental Caries)

Mucous Membrane — Ulcerating: Gastrointestinal

  • Crohn’s Disease
  • Ulcerative Colitis
  • NSAIDs

Mucous Membrane — Ulcerating: Other

  • Canker Sore
  • Cold Sore
  • Anemia
  • Langerhan’s Cell Histiocytosis
  • Wegener’s Disease
  • Sarcoidosis
  • Drug Induced
  • Sexually Transmitted Infection

Mucous Membrane — Non-Ulcerating: Lighter (White) — Non-Neoplastic

  • Candidiasis
  • Lichen Planus
  • Anemia

Mucous Membrane — Non-Ulcerating: Lighter (White) — Neoplastic

  • Leukoplakia
  • Squamous Cell Carcinoma

Mucous Membrane — Non-Ulcerating: Darker (Red)

  • Gingivitis
  • Kawasaki Disease (Strawberry Tongue)
  • Other Gum Disease
  • Mucocele
  • Allergic Reaction

Mucous Membrane — Non-Ulcerating: No Colour Change

  • Chronic Liver Disease
  • Sjögren’s Syndrome
  • Acromegaly
  • Amyloidosis
  • Psoriasis
  • Gingival Hyperplasia
  • Dry Mouth
